#!/bin/sh
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
REMOTE=antrieb@node1
SOURCE=/etc/inventory/app.conf
DEST=/etc/inventory/app.conf
KEY=/etc/inventory-sync/id_ed25519
KNOWN=/etc/inventory-sync/known_hosts

ssh_cmd() {
    ssh -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="$KNOWN" "$REMOTE" "$@"
}

status=0
ssh_cmd test -f "$SOURCE" || status=$?

case "$status" in
    0)
        install -d -m 0755 -o root -g root /etc/inventory
        tmp=$(mktemp /etc/inventory/.app.conf.XXXXXX) || exit 1
        trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
        if scp -p -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="$KNOWN" "$REMOTE:$SOURCE" "$tmp"; then
            chown root:root "$tmp"
            if test -f "$DEST" && cmp -s "$tmp" "$DEST"; then
                rm -f "$tmp"
            else
                mv -f "$tmp" "$DEST"
                logger -t inventory-config-sync "updated $DEST from node1"
            fi
            trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
        else
            logger -t inventory-config-sync "copy from node1 failed"
            exit 1
        fi
        ;;
    1)
        if test -e "$DEST"; then
            rm -f "$DEST"
            logger -t inventory-config-sync "removed $DEST because source is absent on node1"
        fi
        ;;
    *)
        logger -t inventory-config-sync "source check failed with status $status; destination left unchanged"
        exit "$status"
        ;;
esac
# Mirror node1's inventory application configuration to node2 every minute.
* * * * * root /usr/bin/flock -n /run/inventory-config-sync.lock /usr/local/sbin/inventory-config-sync
